messages.subject: Question about detectionHistory
parts:
Hello, I was wondering if you could help me. 

I have a camera trap database with two cameras per station. 20 stations and 40 cameras. My camera trap operation file has a column for Station (Station 01, Station 02... Station 20), a column for CameraID (camera 1, camera 2, ... camera 40), another column for Deployment which is when each trap started working. I have multiple deployments per station and per camera. Each deployment has a setupDate and retrievalDate. 

My question is is this the right way to input the camera trap operation file. I keep getting this error whenever I try to compute the detectionHistory. Or should my camera trap operation only have one row per camera with the initial setup date and retrieval date, instead of per deployment. 

Error in detectionHistory(recordTable = carmelitaDB_20, camOp = carmelita_camop,  : 
  Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by rownames of camOp

messages.subject: Re: Question about detectionHistory
parts:
Hi Gabriella,
if the cameras ran continuously and were only checked between deployments I'd suggest one row per camera and the start/end days of that camera, not by deployment. 

Also see this thread please.
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/camtrapr/4fvtmKz7Eog

For me to provide more information please share the code you used.

Cheers,
Jürgen
